name: Fate/Zero The Adventure
source:
The story is a prequel to Type-Moon’s Fate/stay night, depicting the Fourth Holy Grail War in which seven mages and seven Heroic Spirits fight to obtain the power of the Holy Grail. The protagonist is Kiritsugu Emiya, a notorious magus killer who has abandoned his hopes of becoming a hero and saving humanity.

[From [url=http://www.siliconera.com/2013/08/26/fatezero-visual-novel-now-on-japanese-smartphones/]Siliconera[/url]]
translation:
这是Type-Moon《Fate/stay night》的前传，描写7名魔术师与7名英灵争夺圣杯力量的第四次圣杯战争。主角是卫宫切嗣，一名臭名昭著的魔术师杀手，他已经放弃成为英雄、拯救人类的希望。

[来源：[url=http://www.siliconera.com/2013/08/26/fatezero-visual-novel-now-on-japanese-smartphones/]Siliconera[/url]]
